review.reason: The dated EPS and Checkout evidence, navigation-only November provenance, legacy Elements warning, outcome boundaries, quotes, and source route are sound. One React Native prerequisite qualification needs repair in the source and concept patch: the May StripeProvider example labels urlScheme required for bank redirects, while the later deep-link handler section is headed optional. The candidate currently surfaces only the optional section and could lead a reader to omit the scheme for an EPS bank redirect.
required_changes: In source-stripe-eps-accept-payment.md React Native paragraph and the eps-accept-concept-rn-scope replacement, state both sides of the May guide: its StripeProvider sample marks urlScheme required for 3D Secure and bank redirects (old raw lines 623-627), while its separate Handle deep linking section is headed optional and explains custom URL schemes, forwarding through handleURLCallback, and unsupported universal links (old raw lines 768-828). A query such as 'must React Native EPS configure a URL scheme for its bank redirect?' must not be answered from the optional heading alone. Add the 623-627 locator and keep this explicitly dated; do not imply Checkout, iOS, Android, or every payment path has that same React Native setup. The existing raw route and candidate locators point only to the optional section, so they do not resolve this misleading selection without the correction.
